data.one_liner: Dart and Flutter SDK for the ConfigCat hosted feature flag and toggle service.
data.what_it_does: Allows managing feature toggles across apps by fetching configuration and evaluating feature flags with user-specific targeting and caching support.
use_when: You use ConfigCat as a hosted feature flag management service in your Flutter or Dart app.
You need targeted rollouts or percentage-based rollouts based on user attributes.
avoid_when: You prefer managing your remote configurations using Firebase Remote Config.
You do not need a third-party hosted feature flagging service.
strengths: Supports multiple polling modes and external caching mechanisms like shared preferences.
Provides built-in support for user targeting and snapshots.
weaknesses: Requires a paid or hosted third-party service (ConfigCat) to function.
Breaking changes in recent minor versions (e.g., Hooks parameter changes in 5.1.0).
data.setup_notes: Requires an SDK Key from the ConfigCat dashboard and optional setup for caching.

alternatives.name: firebase_remote_config
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you prefer using Firebase for managing your remote configurations and feature flags.
